issue.title: Pin the captured timestamp in highlights ingest mode-equivalence test
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-ha.3 note #2 (2026-11-05). tests/cli/highlights/ingest.rs::create_keeps_intake_for_flag_config_env_and_dry_run saves legacy_output from --keep, then compares entire stdout from config-disabled and env-disabled invocations at lines 409 and 429. The captured timestamp is minute precision and those invocations can straddle a minute boundary. Reported failure compared 15:43 against 15:44; isolated rerun passed. Pin a supported deterministic clock consistently across these invocations, or compare stable output separately while explicitly checking captured timestamp semantics. Preserve mode-equivalence coverage and verify the focused test plus just check. This is distinct from bob-cli-h6 / h8.6 timezone assertions in overwrite_local.rs; no glued-timing code is involved. No same-tree reproduction was attempted by the lander; fail/pass provenance is the proposing phase note.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase bob-cli-ha.3 note #2 records one full-suite failure at ingest.rs:429 (15:43 vs 15:44) and one isolated pass on the unchanged tree. Frequency and serial recurrence are unknown. Source review confirms successive real-clock stdout equality comparisons.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ha.3 proposed this unrelated minute-rollover flake after just check failed and the isolated unchanged test passed; landing review confirmed the test compares complete output from successive real-clock subprocesses.

payload.description: Both concern captured timestamps, but hf is an ingest minute-rollover equality flake and h6 is deterministic overwrite timezone coverage
